Growing your career together

Empowering Farmers to Grow More With Less

As a true purpose—driven organization, Netafim, Orbia’s Precision Agriculture business, addresses the world’s biggest challenges: water and food scarcity in a growing population. Netafim's solutions help fight world hunger, poverty, climate change, and economic instability. We believe in doing well by doing good, and we are proud to go the extra mile to ensure a better world—one drop at a time.

Meet our team

What is it like to work in a place where purpose comes to life?

  • Positive Impact Worldwide

    We're looking for people who are inspired by our purpose to help the world grow more with less™ and are ready to make an impact through collaboration and partnership. Together, we work to address some of the world's most pressing challenges around water, food, and land. If this speaks to you, let's grow together.

  • Social Responsibility

    As a purpose-driven company, we are committed to supporting the communities around us through volunteering and corporate philanthropy. We encourage our employees to contribute locally and help create meaningful social impact.

  • Diversity

    Netafim is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Across generations, cultures, and geographies, our different perspectives and experiences strengthen our company and drive our success.
